title: 01/31/20 - Software Updates
text:
## 01/31/20 - Software Updates
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000066919
We made updates to several Default Widgets this week. If you have customized any of these widgets and would like to update your customized widget, you can find the latest code in the corresponding Default Widget. Please remember that if you have a custom version of any of these widgets, our latest updates have not been pushed to your website.
We updated the design of the Profile Photo Upload modals in the Member Dashboard. Widget involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Profile Image Upload
We improved the logic when saving the Design Settings page in order to prevent extraneous data from being saved in the database.  If the website_design_settings table contains any extraneous data, it can be removed automatically by running the "Design Settings 2.0" update from the "Install New Updates" section of the Admin Dashboard.
We fixed an issue which was causing a conflict when displaying the breadcrumbs on a Post Search Results page when the Post Type has the same name as the "Profession Name" entered on the General Settings page in the Admin. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Function - Display Breadcrumbs
Breadcrumbs are now editable for member search results SEO Templates ( Admin >> Content >> SEO Templates ).
We updated the layout of the "Upload Photos" page when a member creates or edits a multi-image post in the Member Dashboard. New Text label: choose_image_label. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Photo Albums Upload Form
We updated the text of the "Membership Level tags to include" section when creating a newsletter to "Membership Plan tags to include".
We added the ability to edit the display order of members in the "Feature Members on Homepage" Add-On. In order to use this new setting, navigate to the Admin >> Settings >> Design Settings >> Homepage Layout tab >> Homepage Section Order Options for the Featured Members module.
We improved the logic of how edited Text Labels are saved in the Admin.  Now changes made on multiple pages of Text Labels can be saved all at once.
We added the ability to select the background colors of the "Featured Blog Article Slider" Add-On from the Design Settings page in the Admin. To use these new settings, navigate to the Admin >> Settings >> Design Settings >> Homepage Layout tab >> Homepage Section Order Options for the Featured Blog Article Slider. Widgets Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Custom Appearance Settings Bootstrap Theme - Homepage - Featured Blog Posts Slider
We updated the Details Page of multi-image posts to loop back to the first image when clicking the Right Arrow on the final image of the post. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Photo Album Page
We updated the Lead Settings page in the Admin to prevent a Membership Plan from being selected for multiple different Actions.
We improved the load speed of the Transaction History page in the Admin.
We added a "Copy Shortcode" option when editing individual items on the Widget Manager, Menu Manager, and Form Manager pages in the Admin.
We fixed an issue which was causing the system to show an error message when filtering for a keyword that returns no results on the Reviews page in the Member Dashboard. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Reviews Datatable
We fixed an issue which was preventing the Google Location field on the Lead Form from respecting the "Location Fields Required" lead setting in some cases. Widget Involved: Bootstrap - Contact Member Lead Map
We added the Events Calendar as a new Homepage Section option in the Design Settings. Admin >> Settings >> Design Settings >> Homepage Layout tab >> Homepage Section Order. Widgets Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Display - Events Calendar Bootstrap Theme - Homepage
We fixed an issue which was preventing users from changing the display order of images for multi-image post photos on mobile devices. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Photo Albums Order Photos
We fixed an issue that was preventing submissions of the "Listing - Verify Account" form from displaying properly on the Form Inquiries page in the Admin in some cases.
